method: Read the capsuleForConsumer refusal state for the SAME attempt under both arms and map it to a source-derived eligibility class; the mapping is arm-independent.
keyProperty: eligibility is judged from the SOURCE for both experimental arms before randomization, so a candidate task qualifies on actual Work/Trajectory facts rather than on which arm it drew (§8.4)
remainingUncertainty: Eligibility classes are derived from the existing capsuleForConsumer refusal vocabulary; a future benchmark may need a finer-grained source fact, which would be added in a later stage.
